title: International Student Mobility in Higher Education
passage: Global student mobility has surged over the past two decades as universities worldwide expand their international recruitment programs. Cross-border education fosters academic collaboration and drives economic contributions in destination cities. International students often face initial challenges, including cultural acclimatization and language adjustments. However, institutions that provide dedicated orientation programs and language support witness significantly higher retention rates and academic achievement among their international cohorts.
